In detail

A large outer-Pest district with a genuinely mixed record in the sources checked for this build: a June 2023 district safety comparison named it among Budapest's comparatively safe districts where "residents can feel secure," while a later, July 2025 citywide theft-hotspot map (built from the prior month's police data) named District XV alongside the inner Bulinegyed districts as one of the areas with the most recorded thefts. Both findings are disclosed here rather than picking one, consistent with this rating sitting between the two. Sources checked: BPhirek.hu, 1 Jun 2023 (comparatively safe districts); Metropol.hu, 20 Jul 2025 (30-day crime-hotspot map).
